proposed_ingestion_schema.format: GeoPackage snapshots + provenance/rights JSON; explicit source CRS; normalized UTC times; JSON fields are proposed required contract, not received data

fields.rule: Versioned format; stable event and snapshot identifiers. Event year2019–2024 allowlist; duplicate IDs rejected.

fields.type: GeoPackage layer or GeoJSON geometry + enum
fields.rule: Separate active_front_line, contained_front_line, burned_extent_polygon, estimated_perimeter_polygon, ignition_point. Points never silently become polygons.
WKT authoritative if EPSG unknown; preserve source CRS and axis order. No guessing. Unknown CRS quarantined.
Preserve source text and time interval. UTC conversion needs explicit timezone evidence. Start<=end; ambiguous local dates quarantined.
Unknowns remain null. Retrospective label may be accepted when rights/time/geometry verified; operational predictor feature only when available_at<=issue and evidence exists.
Retain every source revision; no overwrite. Future-informed corrected boundaries cannot be declared as-of predictors.
Differentiate helicopter,drone,ground,manual map,satellite. Unknown footprint prevents interpreting uncovered cells as negative.
Missing uncertainty explicitly unknown; image-to-map work includes GCP residual/digitization error. No invented zero uncertainty.
Partial line/non-observation never treated as safe negative; suppression evidence timestamped separately.
Preserve immutable source and provenance; archive members each hashed; derived files link parent SHA and transformations.
Explicit separate rights for research training, validation, derivative GIS, model publication, demo, commercial service, raw redistribution. Unknown rights quarantine for training.
Pre-register related event/time groups and partitions before outcomes. Approved_use is metadata_only, retrospective_label, or asof_feature; holdout2025 excluded.

acceptance_guards: Reject/quarantine missing CRS, ambiguous timezone, nonmonotonic observation intervals, missing raw rights, or inconsistent geometry type.
Do not silently correct NIFOS Case4 date discrepancy; retain discrepancy record pending original verification.
Check projected lengths/areas and coordinate ranges, polygon validity and islands; do not automatically buffer lines into full burned polygons.
Record exact/reconstructed/estimated label provenance separately; GIS coordinate precision does not prove ground accuracy.
First-approach label between observed outside and observed inside is interval-censored; do not impute exact arrival or interpolate1h from daily burn maps.
A full outside observation at t may contribute censoring only over verified covered domain; cloud/partial/unobserved never automatically negative.
Issue candidates and features use predeclared region plus inputs actually available at issue; future/final bounds used only in evaluation labels.
Reference year, acquisition interval, publication date and revision date remain separate; e.g.WorldCover2021 release2022-10-28 is not March2022 operational input.
No location identifiers, event year or absolute coordinates automatically added as predictive features.
Real terrain/landcover alone does not calibrate physical fuel, smoke exposure, injury or evacuation response probability.
